items.text:
Increasing our healthcare workforce is critical so we can better serve our 'ohana in rural and remote communities.🩺

Mahalo to @uhmedjabsom leadership and current JABSOM students for attending today's #RuralHealthTalkStory on how we can continue to support workforce development. https://t.co/V1WX6KcJro

Today, Iowa became the latest state to attack women's healthcare by implementing a ban on abortions after six weeks. We must stop GOP extremist attacks on abortion & IVF. Proud to join @ProChoiceCaucus for #ReproductiveFreedomWeekofAction 
because our fight is far from over.🧵 https://t.co/uVwk4hyn1T

Medicare & Medicaid turn 59 today! 

This landmark law allows hundreds of thousands of keiki and kupuna in Hawai'i to access quality, affordable healthcare. I am committed to ensuring  healthcare remains a right for everyone in our communities & across the country. https://t.co/3suze43Bi1

Honored to speak at @HI_PacificAHEC @uhmedjabsom Hawai'i Health Workforce Summit to discuss supporting Maui, reimbursements that reflect our cost of care & retaining our healthcare workers. Mahalo to our medical professionals who support a healthier future for our ‘ohana. ❤️ https://t.co/j1P4w8aiLi

I testified before House Veterans' Affairs about my Parity for Native Hawaiian Veterans Act, to improve healthcare access and affordability for our Native Hawaiian veterans. I will continue fighting for fair and equal treatment and honor the sacrifice of all our veterans. https://t.co/a8yAxDM6ST

Your reminder that extremist Republicans want to:

❌ Raise taxes
❌ Cut Medicaid & Social Security
❌ Eliminate Head Start for 3,000 keiki in Hawaii

Project 2025 hurts our hard working ʻohana. I will keep fighting to ensure these policies never see the light of day. https://t.co/wzuQD0Ox7F

Happy to speak at Community First's Hawai‘i Healthcare Conference & discuss our work in Congress to increase access to health care. Also ran into @HMHBHawaii & checked out their mobile health clinic. Mahalo for your work with our mothers & babies, & showing me Big Mama! 🚐 https://t.co/oVt7OABu4N

HOSA academies, like the one I visited at Waimea High on Kauai, are working to solve our healthcare workforce shortages in  in Hawaii. Proud to support programs shaping the next generation of healthcare leaders, many of them first-gen college students! #RuralHealthMonth https://t.co/FeAsEroDvO

As a mother, I can't vote for a bill that strips away healthcare from the children of our military families. Every child deserves to be their authentic selves & receive the care that helps them live freely. 

Gender-affirming care is healthcare. https://t.co/LU8TaIvAnP

Today marks what should've been 52 years of #RoevWade. Since being overturned nearly 3 years ago, too many women have had to travel to another state or be near death before getting healthcare.

I'm proud to stand w/ @ReproCaucus to restore & protect reproductive freedoms for all.

Had a busy morning on Lānaʻi meeting with our veterans & healthcare providers getting updates on what’s happening in the community. Also visited the Lānaʻi Youth Center and Skate Park, ending with a trip to Maui via the ferry ⛴️ https://t.co/669dQMT5EO

More than 50 percent of the physicians licensed in Hawaiʻi don't live here. We must find ways to draw them back to the islands and help keep our communities healthy and alive. Mahalo to our healthcare leaders for meeting & updating me on how I can best support this effort! https://t.co/hetqONq9t2

With my Waiʻanae Coast Comprehensive Health Center ʻohana today, here to remind everyone that when we talk about funding for Medicaid, federally qualified health centers, SNAP—these are the faces on the frontline making sure our people are okay. We will continue fighting for you! https://t.co/eK5J3LIDYG

America is staring down the barrel of a $2.5 trillion cut to Medicaid that would affect millions of seniors & our rural communities.

These arenʻt cost savings. These are neighbors, friends, parents, kids.

I'm calling for a rural health moonshot. We can and must fight back. @ruralhealth 

Watch the full speech here:
https://t.co/6ZccJTcybM

Republicans want bullshit tax breaks for billionaires and corporations. Guess how they're paying for it:

By cutting off 82,000 in Hawaiʻi from SNAP, eliminating Medicaid for over 350,000 keiki & kūpuna, and increasing health premiums for over 10,000 Hawaiʻi residents.

Hell no. https://t.co/ypdGXn3nWB

This Administration isn't concerned about violating the Constitution or We the People. 

Watching Trumpʻs desperate attempts to justify cuts to Social Security, Medicaid, and food programs was shameful and offensive. https://t.co/vVruD4A6mS

Our communities in Hawaiʻi & across the country are terrified by the Trump Admin's cuts. People have lost their jobs & are afraid they'll lose Medicaid, Social Security, & the ability to take care of loved ones.

These cuts are deeply personal—Republicans need to stop hiding, show up & listen.

Medicaid is a lifeline for over 287,000 in Hawai‘i, including keiki, pregnant women, people with disabilities & more than half our kūpuna in nursing homes. Cutting Medicaid would harm thousands but this isn’t just about healthcare—it’s about the well-being of our communities. 

No cuts to Medicaid.

Visited Wahiawa Health to see how crucial Title X funding supports family planning and preventative health services. With these funds now frozen, clinics like Wahiawa are at risk. We must protect Title X to ensure families have access to healthcare and to keep these critical services in tact.

Grateful to @AARPHawaii for meeting with me to talk Social Security & Medicaid. These programs are essential lifelines for our kūpuna & families who are trying to make ends meet. Mahalo for your advocacy, I stand with you in protecting our social safety nets from threats from this administration.

Cutting off millions from Medicaid and SNAP doesn't mean people will suddenly be able to afford healthcare and groceries.

The choice is clear: do we feed the greed of billionaires or do we feed and care for our families in need? We know what the Republicans are choosing. https://t.co/iBK9utl0rd

Back from over 24 hours at the Capitol, fighting against the Big Ugly Bullshit bill. I watched Republicans cheer as they cut off 3 mil from food assistance & nearly 14 mil from life-saving healthcare. Adding TRILLIONS to the deficit, all for billionaires. This is a betrayal, but we aren't giving up.

If Republicans cut billions from Medicaid with the Big Ugly Bill, families will suffer. A preschool teacher from Oʻahu shared with me that Medicaid is the only reason they could afford life-saving care for their prematurely-born son. Medicaid is more than a benefit—itʻs lifeline. https://t.co/oYUCuMkTDZ

Proud to join my Democratic women colleagues in the House & Senate to highlight the stories of women & families who will be impacted by the Big Ugly Bill. Medicaid & SNAP are more than benefits—they are lifelines for people like Nancy and Charlie who are just trying to make ends meet.

I went on @hawaiinewsnow Sunrise this morning to discuss whatʻs going on DC, from Israel/Iran to the Big Ugly Bill. We need Republicans in Congress to understand that if they cut Medicaid and SNAP, everyone in Hawaiʻi and across the country will suffer. Mahalo for having me! https://t.co/ryA33amB2V
